Its strength is a fixed function of the current token's identity (100% of integrated-gradient attribution on the peak token, rho=1.00 for one-token replacement, no measurable position or preceding-context effect), so the pole is retrospective - it prepares no upcoming token - and the unit's negative pole is weak (max 0.17).
